headers.World-Hotlines-Timestamp: Unix seconds supplied by the sender
headers.World-Hotlines-Event-Id: Stable event id; identical for every attempt
headers.World-Hotlines-Delivery-Id: Unique attempt id; distinct from event id

signature.secret_encoding: 32 random bytes encoded as unpadded base64url; decode strictly to bytes before HMAC
signature.signed_bytes: ASCII(timestamp) + '.' + exact raw request body bytes

retries.disable: 410 disables the subscription after this attempt
retries.terminal: After the final attempt, retain only bounded operational delivery metadata according to the future service retention policy; no payload-derived analytics.

destination_safety.registration_and_each_delivery: Resolve every address and require a globally routable public IP.
destination_safety.redirects: Disabled; if a future version permits them, every hop must be revalidated.
destination_safety.dns_rebinding: Pin the validated address for the connection and verify the connected peer.

secret_handling.generation: Generate exactly 32 cryptographically random bytes and deliver them as canonical unpadded base64url.
secret_handling.rotation_overlap: The current secret has no expiry metadata and remains usable before, during, and after the previous-secret interval. The immediately previous secret requires valid finite safe-integer Unix-second activated_at and expires_at metadata, with expires_at at or after activated_at and overlap expires_at - activated_at <= 86400 seconds. The previous secret is eligible only during the inclusive interval activated_at <= now <= expires_at; outside that interval it is not eligible. Reject malformed metadata.
prohibitions: Never put a secret in a URL.
Never log a secret, signature base, or raw payload.

privacy.minimization: Store only delivery configuration and bounded delivery state needed to operate a future service; delete disabled configuration and attempt metadata on a documented short schedule.
privacy.operational_data_notice: Destination URIs and any future contact details would be operational data of a future service. This repository does not collect or store them.
